title: Alliance Color with when
instructions:
Complete the `when` expression to print the correct message for each alliance color:
- "red" -> print "Go Red Alliance!"
- "blue" -> print "Go Blue Alliance!"
- anything else -> print "Unknown alliance"
hint: Use the when (value) { "match" -> action } syntax. Don't forget the else -> branch.
expectedOutput:
Go Red Alliance!
Go Blue Alliance!
Unknown alliance
